title: Additional construction standards for rectangular tanks exceeding 275 gallon (1041 L).
officialText:
Rectangular tanks exceeding
275-gallon (1241 L) capacity shall comply with the requirements of Sections 1305.14.3.1 through 1305.14.3.6.
